components.name: Gallery Artifact Card
components.description: Elevated gallery card stock with 1px perimeter hairline, top catchlight, and hover-revealed actions.
components.html:
PLATE 01

Norwegian Wood

Haruki Murakami · 1987
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1C1A17; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.07); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 1px 2px rgba(28,26,23,0.05), 0 6px 18px -4px rgba(28,26,23,0.06); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); max-width: 260px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2.5px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.96), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(28,26,23,0.07), 0 16px 32px -10px rgba(28,26,23,0.13); } .ds-card-media { height: 140px; background: #E8E3DA; position: relative; padding: 10px; } .ds-card-badge { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #716B62; } .ds-card-body { padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: #1C1A17; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #716B62; }

components.name: Primary Cognac Action
components.description: Primary pill trigger for Immerse, Save to My Curio, and onboarding commits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #8C5A3C; background: #8C5A3C; color: #F2EFE9; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8C5A3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Gallery Button
components.description: Subtle secondary action pill on warm gallery walls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.12); background: #FFFFFF; color: #716B62; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1C1A17; border-color: rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.28); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8C5A3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Stream Filter Chip
components.description: Toggled stream/sub-board chip highlighting active slice in Cognac Sienna.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #8C5A3C; background: #8C5A3C; color: #F2EFE9; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-chip-active:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8C5A3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Universal Capture Omnibox
components.description: Elevated capture field for URLs, titles, books, films, and instant search.
components.css: .ds-omnibox { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.09); border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 1px 2px rgba(28,26,23,0.05), 0 6px 18px -4px rgba(28,26,23,0.06); } .ds-omnibox-input { width: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 10px 12px; color: #1C1A17; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; caret-color: #8C5A3C; } .ds-omnibox-input::placeholder { color: #716B62; } .ds-omnibox-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8C5A3C; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Swiss Board Tab Ledger
components.description: Borderless horizontal tab strip underlined by a 2px Cognac Sienna rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28, 26, 23, 0.1); padding: 0 4px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 10px 2px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #716B62; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1C1A17; } .ds-tab-active { color: #1C1A17; font-weight: 500; border-bottom-color: #8C5A3C; } .ds-tab-count { margin-left: 4px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8C5A3C; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Curio presents saved cultural objects—books, garments, films, venues, recipes, and notes—like artifacts mounted on warm linen gallery walls and housed inside dark bindery alcoves. Elevated #FFFFFF gallery card stock floats over matte #F2EFE9 warm plaster in light mode and #1C1A17 over #121110 Obsidian in dark mode, with hidden-at-rest chrome and tactile 3D Stripe Press bookshelves.
keyCharacteristics: Elevated #FFFFFF gallery card stock floating over matte #F2EFE9 warm plaster (#1C1A17 over #121110 in dark mode).
1px perimeter hairlines, top catchlights (inset 0 1px 0 #FFFFFF), and layered contact shadows.
Monochrome ink paired with a single Cognac Sienna accent (#8C5A3C light / #C89572 dark).
Content-first rest state with action toolbars and merchant waterfalls revealed on hover or focus.
Tactile 3D Stripe Press bindery stages with overhanging cloth hardcovers, cream page blocks, and hairline tick rulers.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Never color-code card categories with saturated semantic pills on gallery cards; reserve semantic colors strictly for sync telemetry and transient alerts.

rules.name: The Silent Spec Sheet Rule
rules.body: Never invent placeholder metadata, expose internal ingestion keys inside cards, or place uppercase eyebrow kickers above titles.

rules.name: The Tactile Stock Rule
rules.body: Never nest bordered boxes inside bordered cards; let white card stock against warm gallery plaster establish boundaries cleanly.

dos: Do keep 1px perimeter hairlines (var(--gallery-hairline)), top highlight catchlights, and subtle lift transitions on every interactive object card.
Do fold Closet WORN_ON and automatic co-wear links into wear counts and collapsed Lightbox drawers, capping visible inline card pills at 2.
Do use native <dialog> (showModal()), 100dvh units, overscroll-behavior-x: contain, and clamped { passive: true } scroll listeners for mobile navigation and carousels.
Do render quantitative counts (tabular-nums), years, and runtimes in --font-mono-tech.
donts: Don't add role="dialog", aria-modal, body overflow: hidden scroll locks, or synthetic Esc traps on native <dialog> elements.
Don't expand masonry/grid columns past lg:columns-3 / lg:grid-cols-3, or use rounded-3xl bubble containers around stage heroes or board headers.
Don't place <input type="range"> sliders, gradient rainbow pills, or decorative eyebrow kickers on editorial cards or 3D stages.
Don't call React Hooks (useMemo, useState, useEffect) after conditional if (...) return statements in view components.
